An umbrella has 8 equal ribs. Treating it as a circle of radius 45 cm, find the area between two neighbouring ribs, and explain your method (π = 22/7).
questions.modelAnswer: The 8 ribs divide the circle into 8 equal sectors, each with angle 360° ÷ 8 = 45°. Area = (45/360) × (22/7) × 45² = (1/8) × (22/7) × 2025 ≈ 795.5 cm².
